title: Require Web Public Environment Funnel
forbids: process.env access in web source, import.meta.env access outside the public environment funnel, or capture of the complete import.meta.env object inside that funnel
why: The browser host exposes one deliberately projected public environment surface. Direct field selection inside publicEnv.ts keeps the admitted host inputs explicit without leaking the complete build environment object into browser code.
remediate: Project an explicitly public import.meta.env field through apps/web/src/ui/config/publicEnv.ts, then consume the publicEnv projection elsewhere. Do not use process.env or capture, spread, destructure, return, pass, or assign the complete import.meta.env object.
message: Web source must acquire public environment values through the publicEnv funnel.
